info.title: Window Sticker VIN API
info.description: Free, keyless API returning the original factory window sticker (Monroney label) PDF and a full NHTSA vPIC specification decode for any 17-character US VIN. No registration, no API key, CORS enabled.

get.summary: Decode a VIN and report window sticker availability

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: 17-character VIN. Never contains I, O or Q.

parameters.name: sticker
parameters.description: Set to false to skip the label fetch and return the decode only. Faster.

200.description: Decoded vehicle and window sticker availability

get.summary: Fetch the original factory window sticker PDF

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Set to 1 for a Content-Disposition attachment.

404.description: No label published for this VIN

supported.description: Does this make publish labels at all?

available.description: Is there one for this specific VIN?
